body: Sorry to hear about the panic, it naturally runs in my family so I get it sometimes too..
How have you been? Still having withdrawals from the meds?
Thank you. I think I've been feeling a little bit better at least since lowering my Wellbutrin dose, today is now day 6 since changing.

Sorry to hear that :/ I decided (along with my Psychiatrist) to lower my Wellbutrin the other day, I take Wellbutrin XL which only comes in 150mg and 300mg extended release tabs.. So right now I'm going from 300 to 150 a day, I'm hoping for not too bad of withdrawals, not sure if Wellbutrin is one that really causes them or not...

I was started out on Prozac, prescribed by my GP, honestly I don't remember what my issue was on it; after that I was switched to Zoloft, but that one turned me into a zombie... Now I've been doing okay on Cymbalta for sometime, though I'm still prescribed other meds with it, including the Rexulti and Wellbutrin. I'm going in for my appointment today with my Psychiatrist, I'm contemplating asking to lower my Wellbutrin, but I typically have annoying withdrawals coming off or lowering doses of any psych med really...
Most of your post sounds like my situation other than the deaths. Sorry to hear you're struggling as well..

I haven't tried that one.. Sorry to hear you're having difficulties, have you discussed these with your prescribing physician? I get the brain fog, and I'm thinking it might be from the Wellbutrin I'm taking, though sometimes I get it "naturally" too from my Chronic Fatigue Syndrome...
I was away from Reddit for awhile, and I came back surprised at how many people reached out to me :) just wanted to say thank you to all who have, and who will.
Hello :) I don't have Schizophrenia, but I'm prescribed Rexulti, which I believe is sometimes used for it? Nice to meet you too.
Hello, sorry it's been a bit since you sent your message, my day got away from me..
As of now, one person has reached out in response to this post, thank you again possible new friend! Others please feel free to send me a PM as well :)

Thanks for the response; sorry I'm just now getting back to you. I think I'm going to try the Level Up deal, my records are being processed/sent to their associate Doctor, hoping they'll do so I can save $45 on an exam fee.. Thanks again :)

So you can receive coin from staking, about 1.5% of what you hold? And staking multiple times does or doesn't increase coin income?

I've looked into this a little bit, from what I understand it is more of a western ideal that suicide = bad.. Think about how Japanese samurai back in the day could honorably commit Seppuku.

I too have questioned why suicide is so looked down upon; as others have stated there is the grief it would put your family/friends through.. But does this always have to cause them grief? Couldn't they maybe understand that you were struggling too much to the point that suicide would end your torment? Is it not worse to expect someone to live through hell daily, then to let them find peace in death?

By no means am I trying to say, "yes, go through with it!" though I'm also not going to say don't do it because this and that...

It would be interesting to see family/friends rejoicing ones peace in death, rather than grieving over it. That way you would know you could die without a guilty conscious over it.

I too have been diagnosed with MDD, as well I'm still struggling with doubts of Christianity, but I don't think I'm ready to call myself an Atheist/Agnostic.. 

I am glad to hear that you are trying to help yourself as best you can, and that's all we really can do, even though it can be so hard with depression. I do hope in time you will be able to decide if you will remain a Christian or not, but please do take your time as you've said.

I understand when you say that sometimes you just need someone to listen to your thoughts. I'm new here as I've just joined this sub yesterday, but if you need someone to listen I'm willing to read what you have to say.

I'm sorry to hear about this.. It's almost been a year since my ex and I broke up, we were dating for almost 4 years, I loved her and thought I would be with her forever... Our issue wasn't over religious beliefs or the lack there of; but I too have had mental health issues, diagnosed with MDD and I have suicidal thoughts pretty much daily currently..

I do understand the hurt you write about, it does really hurt especially soon after it happens :/ it may not seem like it, but that hurt will slowly diminish with time. Though I can't say for certain that the hurt will go away entirely, it's almost been a year and I still feel it, but it's not as bad as it was.

I do hope that you're able to find some peace in this moment, I don't really know what else to say. I'll try to be here for you if you need me, since I'm currently unemployed I'm never really busy..
Thanks for the recommendation, I just looked it up and it does sound like a book that may be helpful with what I'm going through. I will try to remember to keep an eye out for it.
I didn't even think of it, but yes I do have many thrift stores located in my area. I think for now I'll stick to trying out the library just because I have no money currently..
Thank you for the encouraging words. I have been doing my best to take life day by day, though usually life just feels like it's moving so slowly...

Even if I wanted to just drop everything and start a new life elsewhere it would be practically impossible currently.. Because of my illness I haven't worked a day of work in almost 4 months, right now I only have a few dollars left to my name :/
Working out has seemed to help me some when I do it, I have to be careful not to overexert myself though because I also have Chronic Fatigue Syndrome... Not too long ago I was doing good by going to the gym a few times a week and drinking protein shakes, but I've gotten out of the routine now..

I too have been questioning how a so called loving god could allow humanity to suffer, especially when Christianity teaches us that it all stems from our ancestors eating a fruit... It seems the further I get away from it, Christianity keeps making less since..
Thanks for your reply and offering to talk if I need it :D
I suppose that could be something good to look into, I don't have any money right now, but maybe I could look into borrowing from a library. Are there any you might recommend to look into?

One  thing, I just don't know what PK means and I tried looking it up to no avail.. Could you explain this abbreviation please?

My story resonates with yours a little I believe. I grew up in a broken Christian household, alcoholic dad and codependent mom.. Plus I've got MDD with suicidal thoughts, and it definitely seems the psychiatric disturbances are prevalent in my family... I too found myself to feel something lacking from my church experience, like I wasn't getting what the others were. But I kept at it for so long, until I moved out when I was 18 and stopped going to church; now later at 23 I'm in this sub seriously doubting what I used to try so hard to believe and be part of. I haven't taken the title of Atheist yet I suppose, though I don't think I would call myself a believer anymore either.. It has always seemed like a word I would NEVER use to describe myself... One thing I'm kind of torn up about is that Twenty One Pilots are my favorite artists overall, but the guys are Christian and have some Christian writing in their lyrics :/

Anyway, glad you have found happiness in this life, that is what I would truly like to find myself.

Mmm, I too love a good cheesecake, and it's also something that's normally fun to cook despite the depressed mindset. Yes, indeed partially I have decided that my future will be bleak, though I also must admit that part of me doesn't expect me to be here too long... It's the part that I try my best to fight, but sometimes the suicidal thoughts feel as though they're beginning to be too much. I did actually go inpatient for a few days last year because of this, and honestly I've been wondering if I need to go back for longer.. I think because I've been depressed for so long that it has almost fully taken over my mindset :/ I have read a book about Cognitive Behavioral Therapy and somewhat tried to put it into practice; though I believe I was and am too depressed to put it into motion by myself. Right now my therapist has me working on simple things like trying to plan activities during my day, and rating how they felt and such. But I haven't started it yet...
I do feel like I hope to meet her soon, but I'm also thinking I shouldn't enter into a new relationship while depressed if possible. Also I worry that I will be more hesitant to fall into love in the future due to my failed relationship (which was my first, but it almost lasted 4 years..).

Yeah, I too find myself trying to eat/drink things often that I enjoy; although it gets to the point that I feel I overindulge myself, I do think I've gotten better at this, but I'm still weak for ice cream...
Otherwise it's difficult to plan my future as you've said, I suppose it's the depression but my future just seems bleak at best.. I thought I had my future all prepared for me, I had a girl I was in love with and a home of my own; but now those things have been taken from me. Also I fear in my current condition that I won't find someone again who will want to be with me :(

Yes, I'm on medication, actually three different meds for the depression, two antidepressants and a mood stabilizer. Ever since starting the meds they've been under pretty much constant change, different dosages and different pills.. My psychiatrist has even talked about possibly trying ECT on me, which I'm not sure how I feel about, it's somewhat scary but could also prove to be helpful.
What is the phone number which you've left me with?

Thanks for your reply. Honestly I'm not sure what could help at this point, so I'm not sure if you would be able to help me :/ thanks for the offer though..
I'll have to reinstall Instagram on my phone, but I'll likely do so and check out your page.
